  "AI is moving faster than most organizations can absorb it.

That is the real challenge I keep seeing with Microsoft 365 Copilot and broader AI adoption. The issue usually is not access to the tools. It is what happens after the pilot: how people work differently, how processes change, and how leaders create the discipline to make those new habits stick.

That is the work we do at Synozur Alliance every day, and it is exactly what I am bringing to TechCon 365 Chicago, June 15–19 at McCormick Place South.

If you are attending, come find me to talk about what it really takes to move from experimentation to everyday impact. Whether you are trying to scale adoption, align teams, or turn early momentum into lasting change, I would love to compare notes.

I will be sharing more soon about where to find Synozur Alliance during the event, including our booth and ways to connect onsite.

If TechCon 365 Chicago is on your calendar, let’s make time to meet: http://aka.synozur.com/tc365chi26

#TechCon365 #Microsoft365Copilot #AITransformation #ChangeManagement",
  "What if the biggest blocker to AI value is not the AI?

I think that is the question more organizations need to ask right now.

As Microsoft 365 Copilot moves from pilot programs into daily work, the gap is becoming hard to ignore. Many teams have the technology. What they do not yet have is the operating rhythm, behavior change, and cross-functional discipline required to make new ways of working real.

That is where Synozur Alliance focuses. Change is the work.

I will be at TechCon 365 Chicago, June 15–19 at McCormick Place South, to connect with leaders who are trying to close that gap. If you are navigating adoption challenges, struggling to sustain momentum, or looking for practical ways to help your organization keep up with the pace of AI, I would be glad to talk.

This event is a great moment to meet in person, find Synozur Alliance at the conference, and have a more honest conversation about what successful AI adoption actually takes.

If you are heading to Chicago, let’s connect: http://aka.synozur.com/tc365chi26

#TechCon365Chicago #Microsoft365 #AIAdoption #FutureOfWork",
  "If you are waiting for the perfect AI rollout plan, you may already be behind.

The pace of change is not slowing down, and organizations that treat AI adoption like a side project are going to feel that quickly. Moving from Microsoft 365 Copilot pilots to real business impact takes more than technical readiness. It takes people readiness, process clarity, and the discipline to build lasting new habits.

That is why TechCon 365 Chicago matters.

From June 15–19 at McCormick Place South, I will be there with Synozur Alliance to talk with attendees about the work that comes after the demo, after the pilot, and after the initial excitement. The work of adoption. The work of alignment. The work of making change stick.

If you are coming to Chicago and want practical conversations about how to keep your organization from falling behind, I hope you will connect with me. I will share more soon on where to find Synozur Alliance onsite, including our booth.

If that conversation would be useful, let’s start here: http://aka.synozur.com/tc365chi26
